title: Quire bounded-Kani corpus proof-dependency graph v1
description: A corpus-scoped proof-dependency graph for one bounded-Kani corpus case (FR-007): only the case's own derived facts -- no Contract IR requirement, no cargo-kani CLI option vector, and no normalized subject ABI, none of which the bounded-corpus generator produces for a corpus case. Distinct from quire.kani-proof-graph/v2 (FR-003, schemas/kani-proof-graph-v2.schema.json), which pins the function-contracts Kani adapter and a requirement/options/subject-ABI shape this corpus case has no analogue for. The corpus's generated harnesses are self-contained by construction (no proof-dependency-site marker, no kani::assume, no #[kani::stub]), so every declared dependency edge is Required-kind only; an Assumed or Stubbed edge is refused before generation, not accepted here.
